Counsel for Applicant :- Yogi Sharma,Piyush Kumar Singh,Ravi Kumar Singh,Vaibhav Upadhya Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Shreesh Kumar Mishra Atal Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J. 
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the records.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 99 of 2021, under Sections 406 & 420 IPC, Police Station Unchahar, District Raebareli.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 08.03.2021 against the applicant, his son Manish Kumar Agrahari and one Mukesh Baghel, stating that the informant used to sale foodgrains to the accused persons but they did not pay its consideration to the informant.
4. In the statement of the informant recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., he reiterated the FIR version.

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and that he has no criminal history.
6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that prima facie the allegations levelled in the FIR and the statement of the informant make out a case for non payment of sale consideration of foodgrains, which inherently appears to be a dispute of civil nature; that it appears that no proceedings have been initiated by the informant for recovery of money; coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 03.09.2023, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
8. Accordingly, this bail application is allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
